newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London ease, dealers eye local market.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London ease, dealers eye local market.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were mixed to lower on Monday as investors remained on the sidelines, preferring to trade in the local market in Hong Long, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index fell 27.98 points to close at 14,830.60, after the Hang Seng index nudged up 35.61 points to finish at 14,858.58 in Hong Kong.
Dealers said there were no features among individual stocks and volume was extremely thin.
"This market could be in for a correction but it really is a toss of the coin at the moment," said one dealer.
Banking group HSBC Holdings dropped 95 cents to close at HK$244.05.
